about: When USAG Development 2026-2030 counts two performances as the same element. Own words; digest of same-element.md. 'cite' is the printed page label and section.

repeat_rule.third_or_identical_repeat: no VP, SR, CV or CC; execution deductions still apply

UB.allowable: C VP, SR, CV, CC again

FX.dance: C VP and CV twice, no CC the second time

UB: release with salto or Tkatchev (incl. 7.511 Tweddle/Ray): legs together (piked) vs straddled
cast to handstand vs short cast before it (different connection)
BB: turn amount (extra 1/4 doesn't count unless listed)
acro take-off or landing on one vs two legs
swing-through aerial cartwheel/walkover vs the plain one
FX: turn amount (extra 1/4 doesn't count unless listed)
acro with one or two hands, with or without flight, or free

UB: legs together vs straddled (except releases with salto or Tkatchev)
BB: leg-position variants (e.g. 2.108 arch or leg beat)
stag vs split under one number
FX: stag vs split under one number
front tuck two feet vs step-out
same_number_same_element.cite: BARS 8 §VII.C; BEAM 9 §V.C; FLOOR 8 §VI.C; BALANCE BEAM ELEMENTS 10 and 29-31 notes

FX_pass_different_if: salto/aerial/B hand-support flight added or dropped
dance VP added or dropped right after the last acro element
different element directly before or after the salto
FX_pass_same_if: only extra FF/FHS before the salto
